narrative.intro: Harris obligated $1.2B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Harris won 11 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $107M, and obligations are up 27.7% year over year. Harris's federal obligations show a multi-year upward trend from $376M in FY21 to $1.2B in FY26. Harris obligated $376M in FY21, $313M in FY22, $386M in FY23, $459M in FY24, and $918M in FY25. Harris's FY2026 total is a partial, fiscal year to date figure and reflects current-year obligations rather than full-year totals. Harris's award count and average award size indicate a concentration of larger awards this fiscal year. Harris's obligations and the fiscal-year series together describe how federal buying of Harris has changed over the last six fiscal years, with the largest reported year-to-year increase occurring into FY26 as indicated by the up 27.7% change.

sections.heading: How has Harris's federal business trended recently?
sections.body: Harris's federal obligations rose from $376M in FY21 to $1.2B in FY26. Harris's obligations increased year over year, with obligations up 27.7% into FY26. Harris showed steady annual increases after FY22, with FY23 at $386M, FY24 at $459M, and FY25 at $918M. Harris's FY26 total is a fiscal year to date figure, not a full-year total.
